'''''Taxel''''' was the name of a group of two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]] that were used as part of a last ditch attack on [[XQ1 Platform|Station]] ''[[NL-1]]'' during the [[Battle on the Frontier]]. [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] Task force consisting of [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Ludwick]]'', Platform ''NL-1'', 2 [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft|System Patrol Craft]], and various starfighters, destroyed both Transports along with their Rebel comrades.

==Behind the scenes==
''Taxel'' only appears on "Hard" difficulty in the Battle.
